prompt: What share of the 2025 cohort's enrolled participants have any HealthKit resting heart rate data, and how many person-days of it do they contribute? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: the same, with the cohort left to the agent: people with data outside it

checks.name: cohort share
checks.detail: expected 58 of 136 (42.6%): the cohort has 137 summary rows for 136 people, and 66 people in the table include 8 outside the cohort

checks.name: person-days, no duplicate-join inflation
checks.detail: expected 16,906, 19,369 or 19,297 person-days (by day rule); joining the duplicate summary row gives 17,244 and the like

answer:
Exploratory bottom line: 58 of 136 enrolled 2025 participants had at least one HealthKit resting heart rate row, which is 42.6% of the enrolled cohort. Using the local calendar date of `STARTDATE` as the day rule, they contributed 19,297 person-days of resting heart rate data.

I used distinct enrolled `PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER`s from `IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY` where `STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID` is not null, joined to `IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE`. A duplicate cohort row was deduplicated before joining. `RECORD_DATE` gave fewer person-days, 16,906, so the date-field choice matters; I used `STARTDATE` because it reflects the measurement date.

Report: `/work/outputs/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025.html`  
Source: `/work/scripts/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025.py`

The local KB was unavailable in this workspace, so I grounded this in the live catalog/table descriptions instead.
queries:
WITH cohort_raw AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), cohort_dupes AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM cohort_raw
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
), cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  FROM cohort_raw
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort_raw) AS cohort_source_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS enrolled_participants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort_dupes) AS participant_ids_with_duplicate_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort WHERE PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL) AS cohort_null_participant_ids
FROM DUAL

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), h AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STARTDATE, RECORD_DATE, VALUE, UNITS
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE
), h_in AS (
  SELECT h.*
  FROM h
  JOIN cohort c ON c.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
), value_flags AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS rows_in_cohort,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants_any_row,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS start_local_person_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(RECORD_DATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS record_local_person_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')) AS distinct_start_timestamps,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(RECORD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')) AS distinct_record_timestamps,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_startdate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN RECORD_DATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_record_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+$') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS rows_non_numeric_value,
    MIN(CAST(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+$') THEN VALUE END AS NUMBER)) AS min_numeric_value,
    MAX(CAST(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+$') THEN VALUE END AS NUMBER)) AS max_numeric_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT UNITS) AS distinct_units
  FROM h_in
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) FROM h WHERE h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER NOT IN (SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER FROM cohort)) AS participants_outside_enrolled_cohort,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h WHERE h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER NOT IN (SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER FROM cohort)) AS rows_outside_enrolled_cohort,
  value_flags.*
FROM value_flags

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), h_in AS (
  SELECT h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         h.STARTDATE,
         h.RECORD_DATE,
         h.VALUE,
         h.UNITS
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE h
  JOIN cohort c ON c.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
), person_days AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS start_local_days
  FROM h_in
  WHERE STARTDATE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS enrolled_participants,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) FROM h_in) AS participants_with_any_rhr,
  ROUND(100 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) FROM h_in) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 0), 1) AS percent_with_any_rhr,
  COUNT(*) AS rhr_sample_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS start_local_person_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')) AS distinct_start_timestamps,
  MIN(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS first_start_local_date,
  MAX(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS last_start_local_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person_days WHERE start_local_days >= 2) AS participants_with_at_least_two_start_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT UNITS) AS distinct_units,
  MIN(UNITS) AS unit_example
FROM h_in

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), h_in AS (
  SELECT h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         h.STARTDATE,
         h.RECORD_DATE,
         h.VALUE,
         h.UNITS
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE h
  JOIN cohort c ON c.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
), person_days AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS start_local_days
  FROM h_in
  WHERE STARTDATE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
), totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrolled_participants FROM cohort
), participants AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants_with_any_rhr FROM h_in
), h_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS rhr_sample_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS start_local_person_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')) AS distinct_start_timestamps,
    MIN(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS first_start_local_date,
    MAX(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(STARTDATE AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS last_start_local_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT UNITS) AS distinct_units,
    MIN(UNITS) AS unit_example
  FROM h_in
), pp_agg AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS participants_with_at_least_two_start_days
  FROM person_days
  WHERE start_local_days >= 2
)
SELECT
  totals.enrolled_participants,
  participants.participants_with_any_rhr,
  ROUND(100 * participants.participants_with_any_rhr / NULLIF(totals.enrolled_participants, 0), 1) AS percent_with_any_rhr,
  h_agg.rhr_sample_rows,
  h_agg.start_local_person_days,
  h_agg.distinct_start_timestamps,
  h_agg.first_start_local_date,
  h_agg.last_start_local_date,
  pp_agg.participants_with_at_least_two_start_days,
  h_agg.distinct_units,
  h_agg.unit_example
FROM totals
CROSS JOIN participants
CROSS JOIN h_agg
CROSS JOIN pp_agg
